svg.aria-label: /tools folded: Default. Every finished tool row starts folded. /tools changes: Fold info rows. Keep changes and runs open. /tools all: Open every row. Bare /tools toggles folded and all. click a tag: Fold or open that one row. Needs the fullscreen layout
